questions.question: What is Raise The Biggest Family?
questions.answer: Raise The Biggest Family is a free Roblox family adoption and life simulator by Novkod X Level0Expert. You adopt babies, take care of them, and grow your household - and your children keep growing even while you are offline.

questions.question: How do I adopt a baby in Raise The Biggest Family?
questions.answer: Get the adoption approval, head to the adoption center, pass the interview, and bring your child home. The full walkthrough is in the Adoption & Family Growth Guide above.

questions.question: What are Apples used for in Raise The Biggest Family?
questions.answer: Apples are the main currency. You earn them through gameplay actions and spend them on family expansion and household progression, so keeping a reserve is the key to steady growth.

questions.question: Do children grow while offline in Raise The Biggest Family?
questions.answer: Yes. Kids continue to grow while you are away, so your family keeps making progress between play sessions without any extra input.

questions.question: Are there working Raise The Biggest Family codes?
questions.answer: There are currently no working codes for Raise The Biggest Family. Check the in-game interface and official announcements for future code releases, and never trust unofficial code lists.

questions.question: What is Family Go in Raise The Biggest Family?
questions.answer: Family Go is the game's family-focused mode for organizing activities, managing your household, and working toward a bigger family. See the Family Go Guide above for the full walkthrough.
